content:
This was a pain, in addition to the m3x12 suggestion other people made, when I zip tied down my stepper motor wires with the Gen 2 upgrade, it also meant that wire was occluding the hole I needed to get into. 

 Not fun.
Pre-threading the screw and then using a ball-head allen key (I have a Wera set) gave me 0 problems on this step.
Yeah this step was a ballbreaker!   Moving the fans and going with an M3x12 finally got it done.

This part was already the worst part of the original C1 installation and I hate it again here. I wish they would come up with another solution.

Take your time doing this. It's a pain to get good lighting and space there to align the parts correctly...
With the extra fans for the HEPA filters, the screwdriver doesn’t fit here. I had to unscrew the fans, shift them a few cm over, install the clip, then reinsert the fans.
Whyyyyy (as others have said, longer screw helps. M3x10 = suffering)
M3x12 is the way to go. Easily done from near impossible.

replies.content: I had success by pre-threading, but just barely past the 2nd side of the clip

content: Grabbing the cable from under, through the removed side panel, helps positioning it way better than trying to do it from above
whomever designed this setup for this particular screw and clamp should be brought out back and given a throttling. smh

replies.content: May their Sisyphean task be to insert these screws all day long only for them to come out overnight.  Hmph.  12mm makes it slightly easier.

content: Much easier to use a longer screw such as M3x12
Definitely the most hated screw on the Core One
Very difficult to reach in that spot an tighten it.  Had much more success with a small electric drill.
